desc:
🚨 BUILD YOUR OWN SWAT DEPARTMENT

Start with a tiny headquarters, one officer, and an old patrol vehicle. Respond to incidents, earn cash, collect tactical gear, and build your department into an elite SWAT force.

🚔 RESPOND TO INCIDENTS
Dispatch your units to robberies, pursuits, raids, and emergencies across the city.

👮 BUILD YOUR TEAM
Recruit officers with different rarities, stats, roles, and traits. Train them, equip them, and create powerful tactical units.

🔫 COLLECT TACTICAL GEAR
Operations can drop weapons, armor, and rare equipment. Harder missions mean better rewards.

🏢 GROW YOUR DEPARTMENT
Upgrade your headquarters, unlock better vehicles, research new technology, and expand your fleet.

🎯 HUNT WANTED CRIMINALS
Gather intelligence and take on dangerous high-value targets for exclusive rewards.

🌎 JOIN GLOBAL RAIDS
Assign a unit and combine your department's power with players across all servers to take on massive operations.
